subject: ProdLogic kickoff: attendee roster, ops runbook, and links
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@prodlogic.com>, ops@prodlogic.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ProdLogic kickoff: attendee roster, ops runbook, and links

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We’d like to lock in the customer kickoff so we can align owners, prework, and the implementation timeline. Below are a few proposed time blocks (your local time):

- Tue Sep 30, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Oct 1, 14:00–15:30 PT
- Thu Oct 2, 08:00–09:30 PT

Agenda (draft, attached as ProdLogic_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf):
1) Introductions + success criteria (10m)
2) Architecture overview + network/access requirements (25m)
3) Roles & responsibilities (15m)
4) Implementation cadence & milestones (20m)
5) Prework and next steps (20m)

Proposed internal attendees (please add/adjust): Monica (CS lead), Priyom (Implementation PM), Naomi (Support/Oncall), myself (Solutions). Can you confirm the ProdLogic attendees and whether the SSO/Network owner should join?

I’ve also attached a role matrix and a short prework checklist (access_prework.md). If none of the times above work, please suggest two alternatives and we’ll prioritize. I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Zoom (proposed): https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=bridge-info
Doodle poll if helpful: https://doodle.com/poll/xyz-scheduling-prodlogic
Drive folder (materials): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink

Attachments: ProdLogic_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda), ProdLogic_role_matrix_v1.csv (roles), access_prework.md (prework checklist)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@prodlogic.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@prodlogic.com
Date: 2026-09-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ProdLogic kickoff: attendee roster, ops runbook, and links

Thanks Jonas — those windows mostly work. Can we do Wed Oct 1, 14:00–15:30 PT? That gives our engineers time to join after standups. A couple notes from our side: 

- Please plan for a 90-minute session (we’ll need the full time to cover network and SSO).
- Can you include our IT security contact? I’m looping ops@prodlogic.com so they can confirm.
- For the network section, please include explicit firewall/egress port expectations and a checklist for temporary test IPs.

I’ll confirm final attendee list after ops replies, but plan on: me (Sara, Product Sponsor), Amir Basu (Infrastructure Manager), and Priya Shah (Security Engineer).

—Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Product, ProdLogic

Subject: Re: ProdLogic kickoff: attendee roster, ops runbook, and links

Thanks — Wed Oct 1 at 14:00–15:30 PT is good from our side. A couple operational clarifications from CS/implementation: 

- Priyom will lead the implementation plan portion and capture milestones (I’ll send a sprint-style timeline doc after the meeting).
- Naomi will own support onboarding and oncall handoff; she’ll need the service account emails and any IP ranges for testing.
- Jonas, can you add a short slide with our rollback/fallback policy for canary traffic? That’s often asked by security and ops teams.

Prework we’ll ask ProdLogic to complete before the call (also in access_prework.md):
- Create service account(s) with the roles listed in the spreadsheet (ProdLogic_role_matrix_v1.csv)
- Provide a candidate test IP range or arrange VPN access for initial integration testing
- Share a baseline SSO metadata file or SAML endpoints if using SSO

I’ll draft the calendar invite and include the Drive folder and the agenda. 

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

I’ve created the calendar invite for Wed Oct 1, 14:00–15:30 PT and shared the Drive folder with the ProdLogic addresses I have on file. Calendar invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=prodlogic-kickoff-20261001

Shared folder (view+comment): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink
Files in folder: ProdLogic_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf, ProdLogic_role_matrix_v1.csv, access_prework.md, bridge_connection_info.txt (bridge_connection_info.txt contains the temporary bridge number and testing pin).

Action items before the call (owner):
- ProdLogic: provide SAML metadata or SSO contact (ops@prodlogic.com) — due Sep 30 EOD
- ProdLogic: confirm IP range for testing or request VPN access — due Sep 30 EOD
- Priyom: circulate sprint milestones doc (first draft) — due Sep 29 noon PT

If anyone needs the invite adjusted to add an extra 15 minutes, let me know and I’ll update.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Implementation Coordinator
Redwood Inference
